scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n quantum,backend,frontend -c magenta,cyan,green "npm run dev:quantum" "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.dev:backend: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "cd backend; if (Test-Path .venv\\Scripts\\python.exe) { .venv\\Scripts\\python.exe -m uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 8000 } else { python -m uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 8000 }"
scripts.dev:quantum: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "cd quantum-service; if (Test-Path .venv\\Scripts\\python.exe) { .venv\\Scripts\\python.exe -m uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 8001 } else { python -m uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 8001 }"
